DefinitionRanking.description:
A ranking system's definition, from 1.1.0: the XML in a file beside the configuration. Each
case writes it into `ApiRankingSystem` with `rank_update`, and its backtest ranks by that
system's name.

definition.description: The path of the file that holds the definition, relative to the configuration file.
definition.title: Definition

ranking_method.description:
Required, so the method is always explicit: `percentile_nas_negative`, sent as 2, or
`percentile_nas_neutral`, sent as 4.
ranking_method.title: Ranking Method

DefinitionRanking.title: DefinitionRanking

ExperimentBudget.description: The experiment's request budget, across every `run` that resumes it.

provider_requests.description:
The most provider requests the experiment may send: at least the number of cases, and few
enough that the plan's credits can be hashed.
provider_requests.title: Provider Requests

ExperimentBudget.title: ExperimentBudget

FormulaRanking.description: A ranking by a single formula, the recommended form.
FormulaRanking.title: FormulaRanking

HoldingsVariant.description: A variant of the maximum holdings.

key.description:
The case's `case_key`: unique among the experiment's cases, the default's included, and
not `baseline`.
key.title: Key

description.description: Up to 500 characters, shown in the report.
description.title: Description

HoldingsVariant.title: HoldingsVariant

IdRanking.description: An existing ranking system in the account, by ID. It's recorded as not snapshotted.
IdRanking.title: IdRanking

NameRanking.description: An existing ranking system in the account, by name. It's recorded as not snapshotted.
NameRanking.title: NameRanking

PriorResearch.description:
The prior-research declaration: earlier work on the same idea whose outcomes the user saw,
in Trial Folio or anywhere else. Trial Folio can't verify it, and records it as written.

status.description:
`complete`: the description accounts for all of it, or says there was none. `partial`:
for some of it. `unknown`: the user can't say what earlier work there was.
status.title: Status

PriorResearch.title: PriorResearch

RankingVariant.description:
A variant of the baseline's ranking definition, from experiment configuration 1.1.0: the
weights of the nodes of one parent, with `set`; or the removal of one factor, with `remove`,
and the weights of the nodes left beside it, with `set` (ranking variants).

key.description:
The case's `case_key`: unique among the experiment's cases, the default's included, and
not `baseline`.
key.title: Key

description.description: Up to 500 characters, shown in the report.
description.title: Description

additionalProperties.description: A node's weight: greater than 0, in plain notation, with at most 4 digits after the decimal point and 15 significant digits. Never a string.

set.description:
Node paths, each with the weight its node gets: every node of one parent, each once,
summing to what the same nodes' weights sum to in the baseline.
set.title: Set

remove.description: The path of the factor the variant removes, a `StockFormula` or a `StockFactor`.
remove.title: Remove

RankingVariant.title: RankingVariant

RebalanceVariant.description: A variant of the rebalance frequency.

key.description:
The case's `case_key`: unique among the experiment's cases, the default's included, and
not `baseline`.
key.title: Key

description.description: Up to 500 characters, shown in the report.
description.title: Description

RebalanceVariant.title: RebalanceVariant

RuleVariant.description:
A variant of the rules: one of the baseline's rules replaced, with `replace` and `with`,
or a rule added, with `add`.

key.description:
The case's `case_key`: unique among the experiment's cases, the default's included, and
not `baseline`.
key.title: Key

description.description: Up to 500 characters, shown in the report.
description.title: Description

add.description: A screening formula, added after the baseline's rules.
add.title: Add

replace.description: One of the baseline's rules, the same text, character for character.
replace.title: Replace

with.description: The formula that takes `replace`'s place, so the rules keep their order.
with.title: With

RuleVariant.title: RuleVariant

ScreenFieldsV1_1.description:
A screen's settings in screen configuration 1.1.0, and in an experiment configuration
1.1.0's baseline: 1.0.0's, with a ranking that may also be a ranking system's definition, in
a file, or a ranking snapshot (docs/contracts.md, ranking forms).

slippage_percent.description: Plain notation, with at most 4 digits after the decimal point and 15 significant digits. Never a string.

A variant of the slippage, in percent: a decimal, read and normalized by the decimals
rules.

The case's `case_key`: unique among the experiment's cases, the default's included, and
not `baseline`.
key.title: Key

description.description: Up to 500 characters, shown in the report.
description.title: Description

value.description: Plain notation, with at most 4 digits after the decimal point and 15 significant digits. Never a string.
value.title: Value

SlippageVariant.title: SlippageVariant

SnapshotRanking.description:
A ranking snapshot, from 1.1.0: a ranking system saved in the account, as an earlier
`trialfolio run` of a snapshot configuration read it. The definition and the ranking method
are the snapshot's.

snapshot.description: The path of the snapshot's directory, relative to the configuration file.
snapshot.title: Snapshot

SnapshotRanking.title: SnapshotRanking

VariantsV1_1.description:
The variants of an experiment configuration 1.1.0: 1.0.0's, and the ranking's, by the
setting each one changes, in lists whose order is kept.

ranking.description: Only with a baseline ranked by a definition or a snapshot.
ranking.title: Ranking

rebalance_weeks.description: Replaces the default rebalance variant. An empty list turns it off.
rebalance_weeks.title: Rebalance Weeks

VariantsV1_1.title: VariantsV1_1

description:
An experiment configuration 1.1.0, `kind: experiment`: 1.0.0's, with a baseline whose
ranking may be a definition or a snapshot, and, with one, ranking variants
(docs/contracts.md, experiment configuration, ranking variants).

purpose.description: The question the experiment addresses. Required: it's part of the research history.
purpose.title: Purpose

variants.description: When it's absent, the only variant is the default.

budget.description:
With a ranking definition, at least two requests a case: its `rank_update` and its
backtest.
